headline: Bangladesh will decide its own foreign visits based on national interest
summary: Foreign Adviser Humayun Kabir stated that no other state will determine where the Prime Minister travels, emphasizing bilateral necessity.
details: Foreign Adviser Humayun Kabir asserted that no other country will dictate where the Prime Minister of Bangladesh travels. He emphasized that Bangladesh will make its own decisions regarding foreign visits based on national interest and bilateral necessity.

The statement was made on Saturday afternoon at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Dhaka, following meetings with the US Ambassador Brent Christensen, British High Commissioner Sarah Cook, and the Japanese Ambassador.

Kabir noted that courtesy calls from Western ambassadors to the Foreign Ministry are part of routine diplomatic work. He also mentioned that the Prime Minister's upcoming visit to Malaysia will include discussions on ASEAN membership.
Regarding a potential visit to India, the Foreign Adviser stated that the Prime Minister would visit India if the environment is favorable.
caption:

The statement was made on Saturday afternoon at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Dhaka, following meetings with the US Ambassador Brent Christensen, British High Commissioner Sarah Cook, and the Japanese Ambassador.

Kabir noted that courtesy calls from Western ambassadors to the Foreign Ministry are part of routine diplomatic work. He also mentioned that the Prime Minister's upcoming visit to Malaysia will include discussions on ASEAN membership.

Regarding a potential visit to India, the Foreign Adviser stated that the Prime Minister would visit India if the environment is favorable.

headline_marked: Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer: [[Prepare for another revolution]] if needed
headline: Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer: Prepare for another revolution if needed
summary: The head of Jamaat-e-Islami Bangladesh has called on supporters to be ready for further action to ensure political stability.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami Bangladesh's Ameer has urged party members and supporters to prepare for another revolution if it becomes necessary to protect the country's interests.
The statement comes amid ongoing political shifts in Bangladesh, as the party seeks to influence the future direction of the state.
The Ameer emphasized that the party remains committed to its vision of a new Bangladesh and will not hesitate to take decisive action if needed.
This call for readiness suggests a potential for further mass mobilization if the party's goals are not met through existing political processes.
caption:
Prepare for another revolution. Jamaat-e-Islami's Ameer issues a bold call to action.

Jamaat-e-Islami Bangladesh's Ameer has urged party members and supporters to prepare for another revolution if it becomes necessary to protect the country's interests.

The statement comes amid ongoing political shifts in Bangladesh, as the party seeks to influence the future direction of the state.

The Ameer emphasized that the party remains committed to its vision of a new Bangladesh and will not hesitate to take decisive action if needed.

This call for readiness suggests a potential for further mass mobilization if the party's goals are not met through existing political processes.
